title: JP_HD's Standard Profile
description: A lightweight, clean, and optimized standard profile—perfect for players seeking a stable, modern Minecraft experience without unnecessary extras.
body:
A lightweight, clean, and optimized standard profile—perfect for players seeking a stable and modern Minecraft experience without unnecessary extras.
This profile prioritizes performance, compatibility, and a clear foundational structure, allowing you to build upon it—whether for Survival, server gameplay, or your own custom modpacks.
